title: Two locks, two orders

prereqs.why: The bug is a lock-ordering mistake, which only makes sense once you know what holding two locks means.

hints: Nothing here is wrong on its own. Look at what the two functions do in the same order, and what they do in opposite orders.
Imagine thread 1 part-way through the first function and thread 2 part-way through the second, both having taken exactly one lock. What does each now need?
The fix is to make every thread in the program take these two locks in the same order. Which line breaks that rule?

payload.prompt: Click the line that makes the deadlock possible.
